summary: Standard deviation of the close over 20 bars, a simple measure of how widely price is spread around its average.
overview: This study plots the standard deviation of price in its own pane. Higher values mean price is spread wider around its average; lower values mean it is tightly packed.
The line turns orange while it is expanding.
how: Standard deviation = square root of the average squared distance of each value from the 20-bar mean.
It is the same measure used to build Bollinger Bands. A larger length gives a slower, smoother line; a shorter one reacts faster.
use: Use it to see when volatility is rising or falling.
Some traders watch for very low readings as a sign of a coming expansion.
Use it to scale stops or bands to current conditions.
Compare it with ATR to see two views of volatility.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
Values are in price units, so they differ across symbols.
It treats moves up and down the same way.
